test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, one candidate secured 42% of the votes and was defeated by the other candidate with a margin of 416 votes. If all the votes cast were valid, what was the total number of votes polled?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Loser = 42% ⇒ Winner = 58%

Margin = 58% − 42% = 16%

16% corresponds to 416 votes

Total votes = 416 ÷ 0.16

**∴ Answer = 2600**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

One candidate = 42%, margin = 416 votes

**Formula used:**

Margin% = Difference in vote percentages

**Calculation:**

⇒ Winner's percentage = 100 − 42 = 58%

⇒ Margin% = 58 − 42 = 16%

⇒ 16% of total votes = 416

⇒ Total votes = (416 × 100) ÷ 16

⇒ = 2600

**∴ The correct answer is 2600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Margin

Margin = Difference between winner% and loser%

Percentage Conversion

Total = (given value × 100) ÷ percentage

Complement Rule

If one gets x%, other gets (100 − x)%
